title: Derived caches are regenerable and never authoritative

pins.section: ## 8. Reading content: integrity, tamper and derived caches

onDisk..thirdlight/derived/: deleted entirely while the project is open

steps.action: re-run the pinned recipe over the authoritative blob

observations: derived content is never fetched from an arbitrary URL and never read to determine project state
if regeneration is impossible, previews fail with derived_cache_unavailable while the project, scene and catalog are unaffected

notes: A10: derived cache deletion is recoverable.
